integrity.claim_scope: All finite simple graphs, all fields, exact characteristic-free radical square-zero scheme; graph-derived finite-field counts and component invariants.
integrity.computational_replay: Standalone verify.py (82 prime-field graph instances, direct basis multiplication).

scientific_limitations: The algebra is chosen from a specific local monomial family and depends on an ordering of the graph vertices; algebra isomorphism invariance under orientation is not claimed.
The full-algebra square-zero scheme may be nonreduced. The radical square-zero scheme and the reduction of the full scheme are the schemes determined here.
The counting hardness uses polynomial-time Turing reductions; independent scientific audit and exhaustive literature priority verification have not been performed.

An older graph-counting result is known by publication year but its initial public day was not verified. The date shown is the earliest exactly day-verified primary open preprint among the consulted mathematical sources, not the date of the earliest historical antecedent.
title: Every graph is a square-zero locus in a short monomial algebra
